voidedProposal.name: DEFERRED_PENDING_ALLOWLIST
voidedProposal.reason: A registration-based skip path inside the formal gate would lower test standards.

futureDirectionRecordOnly.concept: Disabled capabilities may later move to independent capability-specific gates with NOT_APPLICABLE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED; when enabled they must automatically execute and PASS before Deployment.

questions.recommendedCategoryLabel: 需要重新定义产品契约
questions.reason: Current clarify/respond is intentionally non-execution and creates no Task, while the old assertions require waiting_for_clarification Task state. No allowlisted capability expresses that lifecycle.

questions.actualCapability: TaskInterpreter structured-output correction plus chat completion
questions.reason: The core ability is TaskInterpreter correction, not current Runtime Task replay. The deterministic Adapter prevents this input from reaching TaskInterpreter, so a direct interpreter contract is the only way to preserve calls=2 without weakening assertions.

questions.actualCapability: TaskInterpreter bounded-correction failure and failed-Task recording
questions.reason: The specific capability under test is interpreter validation/failure. A grounded-provider failure would test a different failure boundary, while the current Adapter prevents hello from reaching the interpreter.
needs_confirmation belongs to the confirmation/authorization capability boundary. Neither allowlisted capability requires confirmation, so replacing the sample cannot preserve the original lifecycle.

questions.recommendedCategoryLabel: 需要重新定义产品契约
questions.reason: The product must decide whether disabled capabilities are rejected before Task creation as unsupported or still create a Task that terminates capability_unavailable. Those are different product contracts, not just different test locations.

The assertions specifically require Codex and one code execution. runtime.status/file.read cannot substitute. The code capability should be verified by its own gate when enabled and must PASS before Deployment.
Records the established owner ruling: do not substitute runtime.status/file.read; restore and require the process.stop capability-specific gate when process.stop is reopened.
